commits.message: Move the rate-limit counter to a shared store

pull_requests.title: Shared-store rate limiting across instances
pull_requests.description: Moves the token-bucket counter into a shared store so the per-tenant limit holds across all instances. Closes #70.

review_comments.body: What happens if the shared store is briefly unavailable — do we fail open or closed?
Fail open for now, with a metric so we can see it. A hard fail would take down every tenant on a blip.
Consider a short local fallback window so a blip does not remove limiting entirely.

linked_issues.title: Rate limit is per-instance, so the real limit is N times higher
